test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word segment in the given sentence.

The wedding was __put on__ until January.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**put off**" is the correct substitute as it means to postpone or delay something.
